entries.name: XboxGamepad
entries.note: Gamepads that speak the xpad protocol are driven by the Linux xpad kernel module and appear as evdev input nodes. The shell's game controller page lists them and pad_rumble.rs drives their motors. No app-facing controller API exists. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: The xpad kernel module drives xpad-protocol gamepads; the controller page and rumble code are tested.
